div.style: color: rgb(75, 85, 99) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.i:
The support bot values availability. The finance tool values caution.
Same fault, same code, same engine — different YAML line.
Changing a fail_mode is a policy-version change.
Changing the mechanism is a D7 deviation.
